facts.v: The curd below the skimmed fat has a buttermilk-like smell and mild acidity
Laban khad (fermented in a goat pelt), Laban zeer (earthenware pot; mixed with wheat and sun-dried into kishk), Goubasha (Sudanese drink of buffalo laban rayeb, cream and water)
Churned into smen and fresh butter in Algeria; in Egypt the fat is skimmed off and made into butter
Milk left in earthen pots at 20–25 °C for 1–4 days to ferment naturally
